description: Add a reaction to a message as the bot user. Specify unicode characters or custom emojis as name:id. Adding the same reaction twice is not an error. To see who already reacted, use discord_list_message_reactions_by_emoji; to remove this reaction later, use discord_delete_my_message_reaction. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History, Add Reactions, Use External Emojis. Changes Discord data; safe to retry.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread holding the message

emoji.description: Emoji as a Unicode character ('👍') or its URL-encoded form ('%F0%9F%91%8D'), or a custom emoji as name:id ('party_blob:123456789012345678')

message_id.description: ID of the message to target
